title: Smoky White Bean and Broccoli Skillet Frittata
intro: This simple skillet breakfast requires minimal prep and moves quickly from the stovetop to the oven. Folding white beans into a mix of eggs and broccoli creates a filling base that pairs well with fresh oranges.

ingredients.name: No-salt-added canned navy beans
ingredients.canonical_name: Beans, navy, mature seeds, canned, no salt added

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F / 200°C. Whisk the whole eggs, liquid egg whites, smoked paprika, and black pepper in a medium bowl until combined.
Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Add the red onion to the skillet and cook until softened, 3 to 4 minutes, checking at 3 minutes.
Stir in the frozen broccoli and drained navy beans. Cook until warmed through, 2 to 3 minutes, checking at 2 minutes.
Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables in the skillet. Cook undisturbed on medium-low heat until the edges begin to set, 3 to 4 minutes, checking at 3 minutes.
Sprinkle the cheddar cheese over the top and transfer the skillet to the oven. Bake until the center sets, 5 to 7 minutes, checking at 5 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven using an oven mitt. Slice the frittata in half and serve warm with the fresh orange segments.
variation: Swap the cheddar cheese for crumbled feta or goat cheese.
conservation: Keeps 2 days refrigerated; reheat briefly in the microwave.
